blocking_issues: No code repository available; only web server provided.

metrics.usage: Compared performance with 13 existing tools; models had best performance in all endpoints.
metrics.evidence: Abstract: 'A benchmarking is undertaken between the models proposed and several models from the literature ... The models proposed are those with the best performance in all of the endpoints modeled, while most of the methods from the literature have weak-to-random predictive agreements.'

important_evidence: In the abstract: 'From these novel data sets, alignment-free quantitative sequence-activity models (AF-QSAMs) based on Random Forest are created to identify general AMPs and their antibacterial, antifungal, antiparasitic, and antiviral functional types. ... Models are freely available via the AMPDiscover tool at https://biocom-ampdiscover.cicese.mx/.'
Benchmarked against 13 published programs (ClassAMP, iAMP-2L, ADAM, MLAMP, AMPScanner v2.0, AntiFP, AMPfun, PEPred-suite, AxPEP, CAMPR3, iAMPpred, APIN, Meta-iAVP).
uncertainties: Fulltext cache for PMID 34081438 contained content about lipid metabolism peptides and not the original article; extraction relied on abstract and metadata. Verification of fulltext is needed.
No dataset link or name provided for the training data; dataset was described as 'largest experimentally validated nonredundant peptide data set' but no accession or download URL was mentioned.
